title: BCC Ruling No. 06-55-1125 — barrier-free washroom in mixed-use unit
code_edition: Ontario Building Code, Regulation 403 (as cited; edition label unspecified)

facts.text: The record describes a three-storey, 420 m² unit with a ground-floor hair salon, residential occupancy above, and storage in the basement.
The accessible washroom initially provided for the salon was removed; the replacement basement washroom was not barrier-free and had no barrier-free path of travel.
The dispute cites Sentence 3.8.2.3.(1) on the required barrier-free path to a barrier-free washroom.
